Of the four G.B. athletes to have achieved Olympic qualifying standard, three were in his heat (Herriott, Bryan-Jones and Ashton). In addition there was Reading's international, Gerry Stevens and Szabo of Hungary.
Two more internationals, Ashton (Reading) and Thomas (TVH) were also doing much damage, so Pat found himself in a similar situation to fellow Irishman Phelan 40 minutes earlier.
